verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bitwarden produces TOTP codes through the integrated authenticator, which lives in the Password Manager vault. A separate Authenticator app can import codes and optionally connect to sync. No cited item says codes generate with no network or that a Bitwarden account is unnecessary to view them. Optional sync only hints at standalone use and is not documented offline or account-free operation.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes
